subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should local avatar failures keep the current generic direct-route 404 and improve authenticated UI diagnostics, or should /avatar/<agentId> expose more specific missing/oversized failure statuses?
rationale: The remaining behavior is an authenticated local workspace file-serving boundary, so better UX could reveal policy or file-existence details unless maintainers explicitly accept that contract.

options.title: Improve UI Diagnostics Only
options.body: Keep direct image fetch failures generic while using metadata reasons and Control UI surfaces to show clear missing or oversized-avatar guidance.

options.title: Expose Endpoint Errors
options.body: Return specific statuses such as 413 or 400 from the direct avatar route, with explicit redaction and security tests for missing, oversized, and outside-workspace cases.

options.title: Defer To Broader Avatar Contract
options.body: Fold this into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41201 if maintainers want one combined decision for local, data, and remote avatar behavior.

recommendation.title: Improve UI Diagnostics Only
recommendation.body: Keep direct image fetch failures generic while using metadata reasons and Control UI surfaces to show clear missing or oversized-avatar guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest history signal for the avatar resolver, size policy, and Control UI avatar-serving boundary.
